text: Alice went back to the table. <break time="0.8s" /> And found a little bottle. <break time="0.8s" /> That had not been there before. <break time="0.8s" /> A paper label around its neck. <break time="0.8s" /> Said DRINK ME. <break time="0.8s" /> In large letters. <break time="0.8s" /> Wise little Alice first checked. <break time="0.8s" /> If it was marked poison. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was not. <break time="0.8s" /> It tasted of cherry tart, custard, pineapple. <break time="0.8s" /> Roast turkey, toffee, and hot buttered toast. <break time="0.8s" /> She very soon finished it off. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> What a curious feeling. <break time="0.8s" /> She was shutting up. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a telescope. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon she was only ten inches high. <break time="0.8s" /> Now she was just the right size. <break time="0.8s" /> To go through the little door. <break time="0.8s" /> But at the door. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice realized. <break time="0.8s" /> That the golden key was still on the table. <break time="0.8s" /> She was now too small. <break time="0.8s" /> To reach it. <break time="0.8s" /> So she sat down and cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Come, there is no use. <break time="0.8s" /> In crying like that she told herself sharply. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she found a little glass box. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the table. <break time="0.8s" /> With a tiny cake inside. <break time="0.8s" /> The words EAT ME were written on it. <break time="0.8s" /> In currants. <break time="0.8s" /> And very soon Alice finished off the cake.
